insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Associated medical expenses subject to proportionate deduction if higher room chosen; no proportionate deduction for hospitals not following differential billing

icu.note: ICU charges covered under general hospitalisation expenses; no specific ICU sub-limit mentioned in policy wording

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies to each and every claim for insured persons whose age at entry is above 65 years

sub_limits.display: Cataract, Modern Treatments, Bariatric, Rehab/Pain Mgmt capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹50k–₹60k/eye; Modern treatments: 50% of SI; Bariatric: ₹2.5L–₹5L; Rehab & Pain Management: 10% of SI; Hospice Care: 10% of SI up to ₹5L; Home Care: 10% of SI up to ₹5L

initial_waiting.note: Not applicable for accidents; waived after 12 months continuous coverage

ped_waiting.note: Coverage after 24 months of continuous coverage; subject to declaration and acceptance

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, gallbladder, kidney stones, gynaec diseases, prostate, varicose veins, transplants, congenital internal diseases, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity (Code Excl 18) is a standard exclusion; childbirth, C-sections, miscarriage expenses excluded except ectopic pregnancy

cumulative_bonus.note: 20% of sum insured per claim-free year; max 100%; partial/nil utilisation of SI does not reduce bonus; full utilisation of SI and cumulative bonus resets bonus to nil

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of 100% of SI once per policy year; triggers on partial or full utilisation of limit of coverage; restored SI usable for all subsequent claims in the policy year; unutilised restored SI cannot be carried forward

domiciliary.note: Covered for treatment exceeding 3 days; excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, arthritis, gout and several other conditions

ayush.note: In-patient and day care AYUSH treatment (except Yoga and Naturopathy) covered up to sum insured; also covered under domiciliary and home care

organ_donor.note: In-patient hospitalisation expenses for organ donor covered; complications requiring redo surgery or ICU for donor also covered; additional SI up to the sum insured over and above limit of coverage

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for transport to hospital, between hospitals, and hospital to home if certified medically necessary; air ambulance up to ₹2,50,000 per hospitalisation and ₹5,00,000 per policy year

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of sum insured per policy period including pre/post hospitalisation; includes robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions, etc.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in List I are covered as part of sum insured when there is an admissible claim; includes gloves, nebulisation kit, masks, crepe bandage, etc.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all investigations and treatments to India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment; coverage not available during grace period except for instalment policies

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability; apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, infertility, congenital external defects, refractive error <7.5D, dental, circumcision, chelation/hyperbaric/EECP therapies, PRP injections, biologicals (OPD)

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy document
